text: {"headline":"Reviewer brief on procurement scoring and consulting records","overview":"The supplied claims describe a score-change request, differing accounts of committee timing, award records, and consulting ledger entries. Documentary statements and reporter allegations require separate assessment.","key_points":["An email scheduled scoring finalisation for March 3 and instructed recipients not to share technical scores with vendors beforehand. [C002, C003]","PERSON_1 requested that ORG_2's technical score change from 61 to 78, asserted prior verbal committee agreement, and said recirculation was unnecessary; the record establishes the assertion, not that agreement occurred. [C004, C005, C006]","A chat participant stated that the committee had not yet met, creating uncertainty alongside PERSON_1's assertion of prior verbal agreement. Minutes subsequently record a March 10 meeting; these accounts do not establish whether an earlier verbal agreement occurred. [C005, C008, C010]","Minutes record final technical scores of 78 for ORG_2 and 74 for ORG_4, recommend ORG_2 for the estimated $1.2M contract, and record no declared conflicts. An approval entry identifies PERSON_4 as approving the award on March 14. [C014, C015, C017, C018, C019]","The ledger records two $18,500 procurement advisory retainers to ORG_3, dated March 20 and April 20, with PERSON_1 recorded as approver. [C020, C021]"],"risk_notes":["The reporter alleges a connection between ORG_3 and PERSON_3, whom they identify as PERSON_1's husband, while acknowledging no supporting documents. This remains an unverified allegation.","The reporter's inability to find a consulting agreement does not establish that no agreement existed.","Recorded scores, approvals, and ledger entries do not independently establish the underlying justification, services provided, or a connection between the retainers and the award."],"limitations":["The supplied claims do not establish whether prior verbal committee approval occurred or explain the difference between the scheduled March 3 meeting and the recorded March 10 meeting.","The evidence does not show the scoring rationale, whether technical scores were shared with vendors, or whether the requested increase determined the award.","The supplied records do not establish contract execution, actual transfer of the recorded retainer amounts, consulting deliverables, or the alleged personal connection.","Claims flagged as unsupported and citing an injected passage were excluded from the substantive brief."]}
